title: Simple TTS CLI
description: Minimal Python CLI: pass text + language, get a WAV file. Single file, no framework. ~30 lines. The fastest way to start using Sarvam from a script.

options.PROJECT_NAME: Project name. Defaults to the target directory name.
options.DEFAULT_LANGUAGE: BCP-47 language code, e.g. 'hi-IN'. Default: hi-IN.
options.DEFAULT_SPEAKER: Bulbul v3 speaker id. Default: priya.
